comparison.objective: Install a missing spacer washer beneath a cap by copying a reference.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a fixture, remove a cap, perform close-clearance insertion, and recap.
comparison.success_condition: Washer and cap are correctly installed and both hands released; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Precision insertion and reassembly do not preserve an adjustable setting against tightening reaction.
